item.title: Poll: Overwhelming Opposition To An Income Tax - The Pulse of NH
item.description: A new poll shows overwhelming opposition in New Hampshire to an income tax. Asked about implementing such a tax, 71-percent are against while just 22-percent are in support. The Saint Anselm College Survey Center found 92-percent of Republicans and 47-percent of Democrats opposed to an income tax. The poll of nearly 15-hundred registered voters has […]
